features.reason: they are based only on prior completed race dates

fundamentalModels.type: equal-weight three-LightGBM ensemble without market init_score

blendFormula: arithmetic blend of corresponding normalized JRA market probability/marginal and normalized fundamental probability, then renormalize to the target race mass

blendSelection.laterBlocks: choose the beta with lowest Bernoulli log loss on all earlier completed OOS blocks only; ties choose the smaller beta

acceptance: record market-blind AUC and sequential-blend AUC/logloss in every block; pair-return testing only after strict-OOS signals are produced
